title: Knowledge Demon

moves.title: Curse of Knowledge
effects: Player chooses a card to add to their deck
1st use: Choose between Disintegration (6 damage) or Mind Rot
2nd use: Choose between Disintegration (7 damage) or Sloth
3rd use: Choose between Disintegration (8 damage) or Waste Away

move_pattern: Cycles: Curse of Knowledge → Slap → Knowledge Overwhelming → Ponder. After Curse of Knowledge is used 3 times, the pattern shifts to: Slap → Knowledge Overwhelming → Ponder (repeats indefinitely)
notes: Curse of Knowledge forces each player to choose a debuff card to add to their deck; the available choices and damage values scale with each use. The monster enters a 'burnt' state after Knowledge Overwhelming, altering its visual animations. Ponder heals the demon for HP based on active player count (30 HP × number of players) and grants itself Strength to increase future damage.
